commons_page_url: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:「名所江戸百景_蓑輪_金杉_三河しま」-“Minowa,_Kanasugi_at_Mikawashima,”_from_the_series_One_Hundred_Famous_Views_of_Edo_(Meisho_Edo_hyakkei,_Minowa_Kanasugi,_Mikawashima)_MET_DP121662.jpg
human_figure: a tiny farmer far off in the paddies; cranes fill the foreground
why: Cranes descending onto winter wetlands is the sandhill cranes in the Delta.
content_change: The kō's north wind is not in it.
crop: Cartouche top right sits beside the flying crane and the signature at lower left; the crop is possible but clips the crane's wingtip.

card_name: Oranges color on the trees / Tachibana citrus leaves start to turn yellow
title: Hamamatsu: Winter Scene (Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido, Hoeido edition)
human_figure: travelers and porters warming themselves at a smoky fire under a great bare tree
why: Gathering at a fire as the first cold comes carries the season, but neither the window's oranges nor the kō's yellowing citrus leaves.
content_change: The card would lean on the turn toward cold rather than the fruit.
crop: Title and station text in the top-left and top-right sky; a top band crop removes it.

card_name: Tule fog fills the valley / Cold sets in, winter begins
title: Mishima: Morning Mist (Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido, Hoeido edition)
commons_page_url: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mishima_Asa-Giri-東海道五十三次之内_三島_朝霧-Morning_Mist_MET_DP123235.jpg
human_figure: a rider and porters crossing in front, other travelers fading into grey fog behind them
why: Figures walking out of a fog that swallows the world behind them is the tule fog filling the valley as cold sets in.
crop: Station name and series title in the misty sky at top and the signature lower left; a top crop and a thin lower-left trim leave no text.

card_name: Elephant seals return to the beaches / Bears start hibernating in their dens
title: Minami Shinagawa and Samezu Coast (One Hundred Famous Views of Edo)
human_figure: only tiny boatmen among the seaweed stakes on a winter shore
why: A wide winter beach with life gathering on it carries the beaches the seals return to, at a far remove.
content_change: The kō's hibernating bears have no picture here.
crop: Cartouche top right and signature lower right over the water; a top-right and right-strip crop is needed.

card_name: Gray whales pass southward / Salmon gather and swim upstream
title: Kajikazawa in Kai Province (Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji)
human_figure: a fisherman braced on a rock over surging water, pulling his lines, a boy beside him
why: A man leaning his whole weight into a river full of running fish carries the kō's salmon gathering upstream.
content_change: The window's gray whales are a sea creature passing, not a river one.
crop: Title cartouche upper left over sky; a left-top crop removes it and keeps Fuji and the fisherman.

card_name: The longest night / Self-heal sprouts
title: Kanbara: Night Snow (Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido, Hoeido edition)
human_figure: three travelers trudging bent through deep snow in a silent village at night
why: Walking on through snow in the dark is the longest night itself.
content_change: The kō's self-heal sprouting is the hidden turn back toward light, which the picture leaves to the text.
crop: Title text in the night sky at top and signature at left; a top band and thin left strip crop remove both.

card_name: Storms roll in from the Pacific / Deer shed antlers
title: Sudden Shower over Shin-Ohashi Bridge and Atake (One Hundred Famous Views of Edo)
commons_page_url: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ōhashi_Atake_no_yūdachi-名所江戶百景_大はしあたけの夕立-Sudden_Shower_over_Shin-Ōhashi_Bridge_and_Atake_(Ōhashi_Atake_no_yūdachi),_from_the_series_One_Hundred_Famous_Views_of_Edo_(Meisho_Edo_hyakkei)_MET_DP121525.jpg
human_figure: people hunched under hats and mats hurrying across the bridge, one raftsman alone on the river
why: Caught on the bridge when the storm arrives is the Pacific storms rolling in.
content_change: The kō's deer shedding antlers is not shown.
crop: Cartouche top right over the dark cloud and signature lower left; a top-right and lower-left crop removes both.

card_name: Newts walk to the creeks / Wheat sprouts under snow
title: Morning after the Snow at Koishikawa in Edo (Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji)
human_figure: women on a teahouse balcony looking out over snow-covered fields toward Fuji
why: Looking out over fields under fresh snow holds the kō's wheat waiting beneath it, as a watching rather than a sprouting.
content_change: The window's newts walking to the creeks have no picture here.
crop: Title cartouche upper left in the sky; a top-left crop removes it.

card_name: Snowpack deepens in the mountains / Parsley flourishes
title: Kameyama: Clear Weather after Snow (Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido, Hoeido edition)
commons_page_url: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:東海道五十三次之内_亀山_雪晴-Clear_Weather_after_Snow_MET_DP123228.jpg
human_figure: a procession climbing a steep snow-laden slope toward the castle
why: People climbing through deep snow on a mountain is the snowpack deepening.
content_change: The kō's parsley has no picture here.
crop: Title text upper left in the pink sky and signature at the right edge; a top-left and right-strip crop removes both.

card_name: Creeks run full / Springs thaw
title: Fudo Falls in Oji (One Hundred Famous Views of Edo)
human_figure: pilgrims standing under and beside a waterfall, one bathing beneath it
why: People gathered at a full-running fall is the creeks running full and the springs thawed.
crop: Cartouche top right beside the fall and signature mid-left on the rock; a top and left-strip crop keeps the fall and figures.

card_name: Bald eagles winter at the mountain lakes / Pheasants start to call
title: Fukagawa Susaki and Jumantsubo (One Hundred Famous Views of Edo)
commons_page_url: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:「名所江戸百景_深川洲崎十万坪」-“Jūmantsubo_Plain_at_Fukagawa_Susaki,”_from_the_series_One_Hundred_Famous_Views_of_Edo_(Meisho_Edo_hyakkei,_Fukagawa_Susaki_Jūmantsubo)_MET_DP121668.jpg
human_figure: no person; an eagle dives over a snow plain, and the reader looks down through its eyes
why: A great eagle hunting over a winter plain is the bald eagles at the mountain lakes.
content_change: The kō's calling pheasants are not shown.
crop: Cartouche top right sits against the eagle's wing and the signature mid-left over the snow; a clean crop is hard without clipping the wing.
note: Rated weak only because its title box touches the eagle's wing and cannot be cropped cleanly.

card_name: Pink currants bloom in the shade / Butterburs bud
title: Temple Gardens in Nippori (One Hundred Famous Views of Edo)
human_figure: visitors strolling among flowering shrubs and trees in a temple garden
why: People walking among pink blooming shrubs carries the window's pink currants, though in open sun, not shade.
content_change: The kō's butterburs are not in it.
crop: Two cartouches top right and signature lower right; a right-strip crop is needed.

card_name: Mustard yellows the fields / Ice thickens on streams
title: Snow on the Sumida River (Snow, Moon, and Flowers)
human_figure: a boatman and passengers on the cold river beside snow-covered banks and a shrine
why: Snow heavy on every bank and a boat on dark winter water carries ice thickening on the streams.
content_change: The mustard half has no picture, so the kō carries the card.
crop: Clean: the cartouche sits in the top-right corner of the sky; trim a strip off the right edge.
note: Its first print went to a window it fit better, so this is a new pick.

card_name: Plums bloom early / Hens start laying eggs
title: Plum Garden at Kamata (One Hundred Famous Views of Edo)
human_figure: visitors walking among blossoming plum trees by a teahouse, a palanquin waiting
why: Walking among the first plum blossoms is the plums blooming early.
content_change: The kō's hens laying are not in it.
crop: Cartouche top right among the branches and signature at left; a top-right and left-strip crop leaves no text.
